text:
anya: heads-up  the i18n scan found a 404 in the ja runtime guide under 'caching strategies' (shortlink to an internal runbook). low effort but needs an owner. anyone able to grab? :wave:
sam: can you paste the failing URL from the scan output?
anya: sure: `https://short.redwood/runbooks/kv-prefetch` (scanner shows 404 only in ja locale preview)
sara: that shortlink was deprecated when we moved runbooks to /knowledgebase last quarter. guess the localized page still has the old url.
kevin: i can do a quick patch. will grep for `short.redwood/runbooks` in the ja folder and replace with the canonical `/kb/kv-prefetch`.
anya: awesome, thanks. also the scanner flagged a missing image in the same section: `https://cdn.redwood/images/kv-flow-ja.png`
sam: image rotation again? if it's missing we can point it at the default english asset `kv-flow.png` for now, with a TODO to re-export localized diagram.
kevin: ok i'll update the link to the english asset + add a TODO comment in the markdown: `<!-- TODO: localize kv-flow diagram for ja -->`
docs-bot: link-scan: LS-2026-789 detected 2 issues in channel #docs  created ticket DOCS-912, severity=low
sara: can you open a tiny PR, kevin, and request review from me? i'd like to confirm the ja preview after the change.
kevin: PR opened: `fix/docs/ja-kv-links-317123`  replaces shortlink, swaps image to english fallback, and adds TODO comment. cc @sara
anya: preview looks fine on staging ja build  link resolves and image shows. thanks! :thumbsup:
sam: quick note for backlog: maybe add a linter to catch short.redwood links in localized content. created CARD-114 for that.
sara: perfect. kevin  merge once CI is green. please add a one-line changelog entry so we track the fallback.
kevin: will add changelog and merge after CI. closing the loop here. :white_check_mark:
